sortieLines.line: Nothing holds the treeline. (No lingerers to sortie against.)
⚔️ SORTIE — Sigrun, Tashi, Ursula take up arms and a day's rations (600 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ Sigrun stood down the Redactor and kept walking — 3 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It breaks and runs — the treeline is clear of it. It's still out there, somewhere.
⚔️ Sigrun faced The Reunion at the treeline... and didn't come back. The party carries the body home. The sortie is over.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Reunion gorges at the treeline — 0 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

💬 Pavel pulls you aside. "I need to tell you something. Last night I... dreamed? No. I was AWAKE. And something spoke to me. Not the System — something else. It said: 'Tell the human to watch the northern treeline.' Then it was gone."
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
The Reunion stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
⚔️ SORTIE — Deirdre, Tashi, Ursula take up arms and a day's rations (22 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ The Reunion mauled Deirdre (-69 health) over 3 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — the party falls back to the palisade, dragging their nerve with them. The treeline holds.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Reunion gorges at the treeline — 0 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
Pavel came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
Tashi doesn't look away. "About time someone fought back."
Not enough fighters to send — a sortie needs at least two besides you, and the bench is bare. (Endure it, or call for help.)

🌙 Night. The lingering The Reunion gorges at the treeline — 547 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
The Reunion stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
⚔️ SORTIE — Deirdre, Daniyar take up arms and a day's rations (0 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ The Reunion mauled Deirdre (-35 health) over 1 round. They're lucky to be breathing. — the party falls back to the palisade, dragging their nerve with them. The treeline holds.
